data.name: Get In Da Boat
data.detailed_description:
THE OCEAN IS YOUR NEW HOME. GOOD LUCK WITH THAT.

You and up to 3 friends are stranded in a procedurally generated ocean world. Build a ship from whatever junk you can find, explore islands, fight raiders, and somehow keep your floating disaster together.

PHYSICS SOLVE EVERYTHING

Every piece of your vessel matters.

Adding or destroying blocks changes its weight, balance, buoyancy, drag, inertia, and overall handling. The game features dynamic water and physics-based vessel simulation.

Damage can affect individual components and sealed compartments, changing how the vessel behaves as it takes a beating.

BUILD WHATEVER FLOATS

You build your ship completely from scratch.

Place walls, floors, engines, cannons, furniture, defenses, and other components wherever you want. Build sails in any shape and place them wherever you like.

You decide what your ship looks like, how it works, and what it can do.

Start with a tiny raft and, piece by piece, expand it into an abomination, a heavy warship, an oil tanker, or anything else you can imagine. It's all up to you.

SURVIVE. SCAVENGE. EAT. REPEAT.

The ocean is full of useful things. And things that want to kill you.

Explore islands, abandoned settlements and trading posts to find food, scrap, tools, weapons, and other useful (or completely useless) stuff.

Scavenge for materials, cook food, keep your crew alive, and turn whatever you find into something useful.

CHAOS IS BETTER WITH FRIENDS

Everyone has a job.

Nobody sticks to it.

While one player repairs the hull, another reloads the cannons, someone else is busy cooking a BBQ... and one idiot somehow ends up over board.

Some plans work.

The funniest ones usually don't, but we know you'll try them anyway.

KEY FEATURES

  • Online co-op for up to 4 players

  • Completely free ship building

  • Proximity chat

  • Physics-driven sandbox gameplay

  • Procedurally generated ocean world

  • Ship battles and island exploration

  • Survival, cooking, and resource gathering

  • Craft, loot, trade, or steal resources

data.short_description: Grab your friends. Grab some scrap. Grab whatever's still floating. Build a boat, raid islands, steal everything, and survive the ocean long enough to regret your decisions.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 or higher
  • Processor: Intel Core i7-3820
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: GTX 1060
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 3 GB available space

  • Processor: Intel Core i9-10900K
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: RTX 3060
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 3 GB available space
